sources.entry: LaunchNext - Classic Launchpad experience, relive old macOS. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/RoversX/LaunchNext) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: LaunchNext is a macOS app launcher that recreates the classic Launchpad grid interface, built on LaunchNow for macOS Tahoe users who lost Launchpad.
summary.what_it_does: LaunchNext provides a Launchpad-style grid for launching installed macOS apps, with folders, search, and keyboard navigation. It can import an existing Launchpad layout by reading the native Launchpad SQLite database, recreating folders and app positions. Display modes include a compact floating window and a fullscreen view, with Legacy and Next Engine + Core Animation rendering options. It offers a CLI/TUI for managing the layout from the terminal, plus Hot Corner and experimental trackpad gesture activation. Context menus cover Show in Finder, Copy App Path, Rename Folder, and a configured uninstall action. It also includes an in-app updater with Markdown release notes.
use_cases: open app launcher with hot corner or trackpad gesture
notable: Imports the existing native Launchpad layout directly from the system database
Two engines: Legacy and Next Engine + Core Animation, with Dock drag support in the latter
CLI/TUI and managed launchnext terminal command
Hot Corner and experimental 4/5 finger native gestures
Built upon LaunchNow by ggkevinnnn, GPL 3 licensed
caveats: Requires macOS 26 (Tahoe) or later and Xcode 26 to build from source
Releases were unsigned in the past; the author may stop renewing Apple notarization, and macOS may block the app, requiring a quarantine-removal command
Experimental gesture support and some features are marked experimental
